name: Neukirchen-Vluyn (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of black, yellow and black below a white banner head bearing the city arms of Neukirchen-Vluyn (black and yellow wavy bars).
history: By deed of the Minister of the Interior of North Rhine-Westphalia of 23 November 1961 the then municipality was granted the right to bear arms and a seal, and by deed of 9 May 1962 the right to bear a banner, consisting of three equal stripes in the colours black, yellow and black.
